title: Print lab
description: A working image proofing bench develops color treatments into a downloadable contact strip.
useCase: Preview image treatments and keep comparable snapshots without switching between tools.
interaction: Choose a treatment, adjust its mix, and print a proof
reducedMotion: Proofs appear immediately; processing, capture, and downloads still work.
limitations: Includes original procedural artwork and optional local image input. Four in-memory PNG proofs, no camera or storage. Images crop to560×400. Canvas2D processing, not AI filtering.
look: Grey workbench with a red-orange still life of folded pale-blue metal and a yellow sphere, a narrow proof strip, underlined tabs and red button.
motion: Treatment and mix changes re-render the canvas instantly; printing captures a PNG proof whose thumbnail drops into the strip from −12 px and −3°, fading in over 0.32 s.
adapt: Filtering is a per-pixel luminance duotone in the `stock`/`strength` effect, mixing `ink` and `paper` colours; `print` stores up to four `toDataURL` proofs animated by the `sf-proof-delivery` keyframes. Replace `drawStillLife` with your default image and edit `stocks` and their ink pairs.
